title: 第696章 血魔夺舍第695章 无上玉玺
slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了
content_zh:
这只金色大手掌发出浩大的声音，金光万丈，每一根手指上面都端坐着一尊古佛。
这些古佛或吟唱，或结印，神态或端详，或狰狞，不一而足，发出宏大嘹亮的佛音，一掌拍下，那血魔一脸惊恐，惨叫一声，随即被拍成了一团血雾。
佛门功法果然把这血魔克制的死死的。
“给我吞！”陈长生鲲鹏大吞噬术施展开来，把那些血气精华全部吸了进去，这一下肉身就增长了足足2000头虎之力，达到了20000头虎之力。
当然了，有许多精血都被金色大手掌给净化了，不然的话恐怕增长的更多。
陈长生不由大喜，他原本以为把那血魔首领给炼化，大概能够增加2000头虎之力，没想到只是一具血魔化身就增加这么多。
那要是把血魔首领给炼化了，增加的只怕会更多。
5000？还是10000？
想到这，陈长生不由伸出舌头舔了舔嘴唇，朝血魔首领看了过来，血魔首领不由激灵灵打了个冷颤，感觉好像被什么恐怖东西给盯上了一样。
“陛下，李公公，我来助你们！”陈长生身体一晃也加入了围攻血魔首领。
“好！有陈小友相助，此魔肯定要伏诛！”大楚皇帝哈哈大笑，他刚刚已经看见陈长生的手段，居然能够轻松斩杀一头血魔化身，不愧是望仙宗的天才人物。
而且那金色大手掌似乎对血魔有着很大的克制作用。
那血魔首领冷哼一声，“哼，你们以为人多就能对付我了！就让你们看看我们血魔的手段！”
血魔首领话音一落嘭的一下炸开，化作一团血雾随即四面八方乱窜。
李公公一愣，“居然逃了？”
大楚皇帝忽然想到了什么不由面色一变，“不好！恐怕没有那么简单，我听说血魔有夺舍控制人的本领，该不会是……”
此刻，那些在远处围观的人原本正在乐呵呵的看热闹，忽然就觉得一片血光朝自己靠近，紧接着就浑身一颤，随即一个个睁开眼睛，眼睛血红，齐齐朝大楚皇帝等人扑了过来。
这些人大多都是大楚国的那些大臣，这一下就被血魔控制，与此同时，还有一些乾坤龙卫的人也被血魔控制了。
这些人反而朝大楚皇帝和李公公他们扑了过来，李公公面色一变，“陛下，这……这可怎么办？”
大楚皇帝脸色也很难看，现在那血魔控制了大臣和乾坤龙卫，几乎要把整个大楚国的高层给一锅端了，这下就很是麻烦。

总不能把这些人全部杀了吧！
陈长生也是眉头一皱，没想到这血魔如此难缠，居然可以化身万千，灵魂同时控制这么多高手，这种手段确实厉害。
有点棘手的感觉，这一下就让大楚皇帝陷入到两难境地。
这其中，还有四皇子，居然也被控制了，朝陈长生冲了过来。
“桀桀桀桀……小子，你不是能么，有种杀了我啊！”四皇子狞笑一声，朝陈长生扑了过来，血魔首领已经从四皇子的神魂之中知道了陈长生和四皇子关系不匪，他正是要利用这层关系。
content_en:
This big golden palm made a loud sound and was filled with golden light. There was an ancient Buddha sitting on each finger.
These ancient Buddhas were either chanting or forming seals, and their expressions were either solemn or ferocious. They emitted loud and loud Buddhist sounds, and when they were slapped with a palm, the blood demon looked horrified, screamed, and was immediately turned into a ball of blood mist.
The Buddhist skills really restrained this blood demon to death.
"Swallow it!" Chen Changsheng launched the Kunpeng Great Devouring Technique and sucked in all the blood essence. This time, his physical body increased by a full 2,000 tigers, reaching the power of 20,000 tigers.
Of course, a lot of blood essence has been purified by the big golden palm, otherwise it might have increased even more.
Chen Changsheng couldn't help but be overjoyed. He originally thought that refining the Blood Demon leader would increase the power of 2,000 tigers, but he didn't expect that just one Blood Demon incarnation would increase the power of that much.
If the blood demon leader is refined, the increase will probably be even greater.
5000? Or 10,000?
Thinking of this, Chen Changsheng couldn't help but stick out his tongue and lick his lips, and looked towards the blood demon leader. The blood demon leader couldn't help but trembled, feeling as if he was being targeted by something terrifying.
"Your Majesty, Eunuch Li, I'm here to help you!" Chen Changsheng joined the siege on the blood demon leader in a flash.
"Okay! With the help of Little Friend Chen, this demon will definitely be killed!" Emperor Da Chu laughed loudly. He had just seen Chen Changsheng's method, and he could kill an incarnation of the blood demon easily. He was indeed a genius of Wangxian Sect.
And the big golden palm seems to have a great restraint effect on the blood demon.
The blood demon leader snorted coldly, "Humph, you think you can deal with me with more people! Let me show you the methods of our blood demons!"
The blood demon leader's words exploded with a bang, turning into a cloud of blood mist and then scurrying in all directions.
Eunuch Li was stunned, "You actually escaped?"
Emperor Dachu suddenly thought of something and his expression changed, "No! I'm afraid it's not that simple. I heard that the Blood Demon has the ability to seize bodies and control people. Could it be..."
At this moment, those who were watching from a distance were happily watching the excitement, and suddenly they felt a bloody light approaching them. Then they trembled all over, and then opened their eyes one by one, their eyes were blood red, and they all rushed towards the Emperor of Dachu and others.
Most of these people were the ministers of the Great Chu Kingdom, and they were now controlled by the Blood Demon. At the same time, some people from the Qiankun Dragon Guard were also controlled by the Blood Demon.
Instead, these people rushed towards the Emperor of Chu and Eunuch Li. Eunuch Li's expression changed, "Your Majesty, what... what should we do?"
The Emperor of Da Chu also looked ugly. Now that the blood demon controlled the ministers and the Dragon Guards of the Universe, he was almost going to bring down the entire top brass of the Da Chu Kingdom. Now it was very troublesome.
We can't kill all these people!
Chen Changsheng also frowned. He didn't expect that this blood demon was so difficult to deal with. He could actually take on thousands of incarnations and control so many masters with his soul at the same time. This method was really powerful.
It felt a bit tricky, and this moment put the Emperor of Da Chu into a dilemma.
Among them, the fourth prince was also controlled and rushed towards Chen Changsheng.
"Jiejiejiejiejie... Boy, can't you? Kill me if you dare!" The fourth prince laughed ferociously and rushed towards Chen Changsheng. The blood demon leader had already known from the soul of the fourth prince that Chen Changsheng and the fourth prince had a good relationship, and he wanted to take advantage of this relationship.
